description: This file contains inline functions related to arena profiling, decay, allocation, and deallocation in jemalloc, specifically for internal arena management and profiling contexts.

methods.name: arena_prof_tctx_get
methods.description: Retrieves the profiling context for a given arena and pointer, with checks for slab status.

methods.name: arena_prof_tctx_set
methods.description: Sets the profiling context for a given arena and pointer, with checks for slab status.

methods.name: arena_prof_tctx_reset
methods.description: Resets the profiling context for a given arena and pointer.

methods.name: arena_decay_ticks
methods.description: Handles decay ticks for an arena, triggering decay if necessary.

methods.name: arena_decay_tick
methods.description: Performs a single decay tick for an arena.

methods.name: arena_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory within an arena, using tcache if available.

methods.name: arena_aalloc
methods.description: Returns the arena associated with a given pointer.

methods.name: arena_salloc
methods.description: Returns the size of the allocation for a given pointer.

methods.name: arena_vsalloc
methods.description: Returns the size of the allocation or 0 if pointer is not within an extent managed by jemalloc.

methods.name: arena_dalloc_no_tcache
methods.description: Deallocates memory without using tcache, based on extent type.

methods.name: arena_dalloc
methods.description: Deallocates memory, using tcache if available, with checks for slab status.

methods.name: arena_sdalloc_no_tcache
methods.description: Deallocates small or large memory without tcache, based on size.

methods.name: arena_sdalloc
methods.description: Deallocates memory with tcache, handling small and large allocations.
